decisions.reason: The laser marking workstation line builds on the firm's established laser offer and was launched only in 2023, so its value is still uncertain and keeping it costs little, which makes the option worth holding despite its modest website presence.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core business, has its own product page and draws on shared consumables and service infrastructure, so carrying it is cheap and nothing suggests its value will not be realized.

The piezo inkjet printer covers surfaces and applications that thermal inkjet does not, fits the firm's strategy of matching technology to each surface, and is too new for its uncertainty to have resolved against it.
